answers.answer: ECAP 四道次后 UTS 为 385 MPa、断后延伸率 14.2%（初始应变速率 1e-3 per s）；粗晶态对应值为 312 MPa 与 21.5%。强度升高而塑性下降（两者均为实测，比较为并列陈述）。
conditions: 初始应变速率 1e-3 per s

claims.text: 四道次后 UTS 385 MPa、延伸率 14.2%，粗晶态 312 MPa、21.5%

evidence.quote: an ultimate tensile strength of 385 MPa and an elongation to failure of 14.2 percent, compared with 312 MPa and 21.5 percent for the coarse-grained counterpart

answers.answer: 显微硬度由未处理态 92 HV 升至四道次后 128 HV（P3）。作者将强塑性权衡归因于超细晶中位错储存能力下降（作者解释，P4）；织构效应未单独分离。耐蚀性未测试，材料未报告（已核对 P5 明确说明）。
conditions: 3.5 wt percent NaCl（未测试，仅说明）

claims.text: 显微硬度由 92 HV 升至 128 HV

evidence.quote: increased from 92 HV in the as-received state to 128 HV after four passes

claims.text: 作者将强塑性权衡归因于超细晶位错储存能力下降，织构效应未单独分离

evidence.quote: interpreted by the authors as a consequence of reduced dislocation storage capacity in ultrafine grains; texture effects were not separately deconvoluted

claims.text: 耐蚀性未测试（材料未报告）

evidence.quote: Corrosion performance in 3.5 wt percent NaCl solution was not tested

uncertainty: 织构效应未单独分离；耐蚀性未测试，两者按材料原意如实保留。
